g.text: Return true if either or both inputs are false.Complete the definition and each of the four proofs.

Definition nandb (b1:bool) (b2:bool) : bool.Admitted.Example test_nandb1: (nandb true false) = true.Admitted.Example test_nandb2: (nandb false false) = true.Admitted.Example test_nandb3: (nandb false true) = true.Admitted.Example test_nandb4: (nandb true true) = false.Admitted.
Admitted marks unfinished work. Replace the definition’s periodwith := and your body. If simpl does nothing, try a matchdefinition or go directly to reflexivity, as the source suggests.
